title: Legacy Model Lifecycle Management for Financial Reporting
business: A financial services firm automating quarterly compliance reports.
problem: The firm's automated reporting pipeline relied on the retired claude-sonnet-4-20250514 model, causing service interruptions and failed API requests after the June 15, 2026, retirement date.
solution: The firm must migrate its API integration to an active model like claude-sonnet-5-5, ensuring the application remains functional by aligning with current model lifecycles.
steps: Access the Usage page in the Claude Console to export a CSV audit of API keys and model usage.
Identify all instances where the application is still using the retired claude-sonnet-4-20250514 model.
Update the application source code to replace the deprecated model identifier with the recommended replacement, claude-sonnet-5-5.
Perform thorough testing of the reporting pipeline with the new model to ensure output consistency.
Deploy the updated code to the production environment before the next reporting cycle.
outcome: Restoration of reliable automated report generation and compliance with current API support standards.
limitation: Newer models may exhibit different response characteristics compared to the retired version, requiring validation of output quality; check this by comparing historical outputs with new model test results.
